summary: Verified bug fix for band exercise checkmark overflow on Today screen. Tested Thursday (dayIdx=4) LEGS + GLUTES workout at viewport widths 375px, 420px, and 768px. All 21 checkmark buttons (band + non-band rows across 6 multi-set cards) render inside their card's rounded border. Consistent right-edge alignment (17-21px inside card.right). No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth === clientWidth on all cards). Band L/M/H selector, reps input, commit action, single-input Mark Done, and rest-day rendering (Wed) all function correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in ExerciseCard.jsx is correct: min-w-0 w-full on flex-1 inputs plus overflow-hidden on card is the standard remedy for HTML input intrinsic min-width defeating flex shrinking. Belt-and-braces overflow-hidden also protects against future additions.
seed_data_creation: None (offline app, forced Date.getDay()=4 via add_init_script to simulate Thursday)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixed and verified. Measurements: at 420px card.right=404, complete-set.right=387 (17px inside) for ALL band+non-band rows uniformly. At 375px: 359 vs 342. At 768px: 592 vs 571. All within card. Band selector clicked -> orange highlight, reps commit -> button turns bg-[#FF4500], single mark-done works, Wed shows Rest day.
rca of the issue: HTML <input> default intrinsic min-width (size attr ~200px) was respected even inside flex-1, pushing content past card padding on band rows (which have ~108px L/M/H buttons preceding input). Fix: min-w-0 + w-full on inputs lets flex shrink them; overflow-hidden on card clips residual bleed. Verified: getBoundingClientRect check button.right <= card.right holds for all rows at all widths.
